about: Backend developer focused on automation, chatbots and server-side logic. I write in Java and Python, and work remotely.
Over the past two years I've shipped 19+ projects: Discord and Telegram bots on JDA and Aiogram, Minecraft plugins on Spigot/Paper, REST APIs on Spring Boot with PostgreSQL and Redis.
Open to commercial work and team collaboration — reach out on Telegram or Discord.
